production_safety_officer: Certified 1st AD & CSATF Unit Safety Coordinator

standby_emergency.nearest_trauma_center: Regional Level-1 Trauma Center (<12 min EMS response)

hazards.hazard_description: High-acceleration robotic motion-control arm sweep and track pinch-point envelope.
engineering_controls: SIL-3 hardware E-stop lanyard at Video Village & Rig Base
Optical LiDAR/laser perimeter safety curtain interlock
Dry-run kinematic envelope sweep at 25% velocity prior to talent entry
hazards.notes: CSATF Bulletin #40 (Robotic Camera & Motion Control Safety).

hazards.hazard_description: Class 3B/4 coherent optical scan & specular beam termination hazard (NOHD perimeter).
engineering_controls: Certified Laser Safety Officer (LSO/RSO) beam-stop termination
Beam path elevated above/below eye level with matte baffles
Interlocked beam shutter & wavelength-specific viewing barrier
hazards.notes: CSATF Bulletin #25 (Laser Safety) & ANSI Z136.1 NOHD clearance.

hazards.hazard_description: Overhead truss/softbox rigging, tensioned wire/fabric loads, and elevated working-at-height perimeter.
engineering_controls: Secondary rated steel safety cables on all overhead fixtures & truss points
Certified load-cell shackles with 5:1 working load limit (WLL) safety factor
Tool-tether lanyards and barricaded drop-zone beneath riggers
hazards.notes: CSATF Bulletin #1 (Overhead Rigging / Fall Protection) & ANSI E1.6.

hazards.hazard_description: High-velocity wind-tunnel laminar smoke / atmospheric SFX particulate dispersion.
engineering_controls: NFPA 160 atmospheric SFX permit & purge exhaust
Whip-check cables on high-pressure air manifolds

scene_safety_specs.jsa_notes: 10.0m wire rigging & Bolt Cinebot high-speed kinetic sweep envelope + atmospheric SFX. Tailgate safety briefing verified.

hazards.hazard_description: Atmospheric haze/smoke particulate dispersion, high-pressure air/SFX manifold, or thermal ignition.
engineering_controls: NFPA 160 / AHJ atmospheric SFX permit & CO2/smoke detector bypass watch
High-volume stage purge exhaust & air-quality particulate monitor
Whip-check safety cables on all pressurized pneumatic manifolds
ppe_required: NIOSH N95 / P100 particulate respirator (SFX crew)
Nomex FR apron near ignition sources
hazards.responsible_supervisor: Licensed SFX Coordinator / Fire Safety Officer
hazards.notes: CSATF Bulletin #16 (Pyrotechnic Special Effects & Atmospheric Haze).
